name: Alliance Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Alliance Material Co., Ltd., based in Zhubei, Taiwan, is a leading provider of specialized products for optical material cutting within the Taiwanese market. Established in 1984, the company offers a comprehensive range of items, including various adhesive tapes (such as black and white, traction, shading-reflective, removable, and foam types), optical glues, advanced optical/structural molding adhesives, and protective films. Its product portfolio further encompasses crucial light management components like upper and lower diffusers, reflectors, and brightening films, as well as essential materials used in LED manufacturing. Beyond its product catalog, Alliance Material also provides diverse processing services, specifically cut-and-roll conversion, slitting and rewinding, coil handling, and precision die-cutting.
